description: R6 pre-optimisation baseline for buildGrammarPracticeQueue. See docs/contracts/ci-shard-balance-plan.md — U1.
notes: Wall-clock baseline measured against the pre-R6 selection.js (commit 07203e83^). Call-count baseline captured via scripts/count-grammar-create-question-calls.mjs: pre-opt 10255, post-opt 3413 per single build (seed=1, size=10, 510 templates). Measured reduction is 3.00x rather than the aspirational 5x in the R6 contract — the memo dedupes within a single build only and each of the ~10 pick iterations uses a distinct candidateSeed, so the cache is effectively rebuilt per iteration. R6.AC5 tripwire asserts post-opt count <= baseline / 2 to catch regressions that bypass the memo while tolerating small content-driven shifts.
